chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub, from 'Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Isma'il ibn Marrar, from Yunus, from 'Ali ibn Abi Hamzah, from Abu Basir, who said:

I said: A man was performing tamattu' and then entered into ihram for hajj. He said: He is not to perform tawaf of the House until he comes to 'Arafat. So if he performs tawaf before coming to Mina without an excuse, that tawaf is not counted.

key_terms.أَهَلَّ بِالْحَجِّ: entered into ihram for hajj and commenced its rites
key_terms.عَرَفَاتٍ: the plain of 'Arafat, a principal station of hajj
key_terms.عِلَّةٍ: a valid excuse or legally recognized reason
key_terms.مِنًى: Mina, one of the sacred locations of hajj rites

ai.seo_question: Can a pilgrim performing hajj al-tamattu' do tawaf al-hajj before going to Mina?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning the mutamatti' in hajj al-tamattu'. It states that the tawaf of hajj should not be performed before proceeding to the prescribed rites, and if it is done before coming to Mina without a valid excuse, it is not considered valid.
